Success preparedness aur hard work par depend karta hai.
Mind powerful servant hai, terrible master mat bano.
"Vision ko chase kar, paise ko nahi."
Best thinking heart se aata.
Khud hokar duniya badlo.
"Ya toh mehnat, ya phir afsos—dono me se."
Tumhe kai haar ka samna hoga, par khud ko haarna mat dena.
"Tera goal bas thoda out of reach ho."
Mehnat hi success ka raasta hai.
Roshni ki taraf dekho, parchhaiyan peeche chhut jayengi.
Mushkile hi zindagi ko dilchasp banati hain, aur unhe jeetna zindagi ko matlab deta hai.
